evt_critical_minerals_cartel.whatChanged: Minerals Security Partnership (MSP) members committed $180M in public financing for graphite and rare earth processing in Africa and Australia.
evt_critical_minerals_cartel.background: China refines 60% of the world's lithium and over 90% of rare earth elements, prompting the US, EU, and QUAD partners to establish the Minerals Security Partnership.

verification.method: US State Department official communiques and IEA Critical Minerals Market reports

updateHistory.whatChanged: Formation of the Minerals Security Partnership (MSP) announced at PDAC Toronto.
Launch of the MSP Finance Network uniting G7 export credit agencies.

evt_greenland_superpower_scramble.priorityRationale: Arctic minerals and sovereignty contestation: Greenland holds massive unexploited deposits of rare earth elements and critical battery metals.
evt_greenland_superpower_scramble.whatChanged: Greenland's parliament approved regulatory guidelines for strategic mineral mining while maintaining bans on uranium extraction.
evt_greenland_superpower_scramble.background: President Trump's 2019 proposal to purchase Greenland highlighted its critical strategic value; Greenland balances autonomy from Denmark with great-power mineral interest.

verification.method: Naalakkersuisut (Government of Greenland) mineral licencing records

updateHistory.whatChanged: Diplomatic row over US proposal to purchase Greenland firmly rejected by Nuuk and Copenhagen.
US Export-Import Bank issued letter of interest for $650M financing for Kvanefjeld/Tanbreez rare earth project.

evt_greenland_pituffik_space_defense.priorityRationale: Northernmost US military installation: operates AN/FPS-132 phased array radar detecting intercontinental ballistic missile launches over the Arctic.
evt_greenland_pituffik_space_defense.whatChanged: US Space Force 12th Space Warning Squadron commissioned updated telemetry receivers for deep space tracking at Pituffik Space Base.
evt_greenland_pituffik_space_defense.background: Established under the 1951 US-Denmark defense agreement as Thule Air Base, it was renamed Pituffik Space Base in 2023, serving as a critical node in NORAD's early warning architecture.

verification.method: US Space Force official announcements and NORAD operational readiness bulletins

updateHistory.whatChanged: Thule Air Base officially renamed Pituffik Space Base to honor local Greenlandic heritage.
Upgraded solid-state early warning radar integration completed with Space Command.
